Usage: ryoku <command>\n\n update:
Usage: ryoku <command>

  update         update the Ryoku packages (or channel commits), redeploy, reload
  update --system  the same, plus your distribution's own upgrade (pacman -Syu)
  update -v      the same, streaming the full raw output instead of the summary
  update --gui   run the update in the background, driven from Ryoku Hub
  track <chan>   packages: stable|unstable|v<tag>; add --source to build from a checkout
  rollback       list releases and snapshots; --to <tag> puts the Ryoku set back on that release
  rollback [id]  guide restoring snapshot <id> from the boot menu
  snapshots      list snapper snapshots
  status         version, commits behind the channel, snapshot count
  version        print the running version (--branch = channel · sha)
  materialize    lay the base configs into ~/.config (keeps your overrides)
  reset [path]   drop a user_edits override (no path: all, -y skips confirm)
  owner <path>   who writes a config path, and where your change should go (--json, --map)
  reload         restart the shell and reload Hyprland
  wm <cmd>       compositor: status, use <name>, act <id>, session
  deploy         DEV ONLY: deploy from a repo checkout (RYOKU_REPO)
  recovery       last resort: reset to main and redeploy (overwrites configs)
  doctor         run convergent reconcilers (idempotent stateful fixes)
  verify         report whether this box matches the release its channel serves
  debug          print a shareable diagnostic bundle for bug reports
  keyring        show or set how the GNOME keyring unlocks at sign-in
  security-key   enroll and wire a FIDO2/U2F security key for PAM
  import <path>  bring an existing config in: scan, resolve clashes, apply (--undo)
  plugin <cmd>   install/remove/list/validate a shell plugin from git

Usage: ryoku plugin <command>\\n\\n new:
Usage: ryoku plugin <command>

  new <id> [--bar|--desktop|--popout|--sidebar] [--name N] [--author "N <m>"] [--to <dir>]

  share <id>                         export and open the Ryostore PR flow

Usage: ryoku wm <command>

  status            print the detected provider, its capabilities and workspace model

  act <id> [args]   dispatch a window-manager action through the provider
  session           print the provider's wayland-session desktop entry
